# Attri Industries

> Attri Industries is an Indian direct-selling company making 100% natural, Ayurvedic personal care, wellness and kitchen products — onion shampoo & hair oil, herbal face wash, glutathione cream, herbal toothpaste, Tulsi drops, sanitary pads, and pure kitchen masale. Paraben-free, made in India. We also offer a referral-based earning opportunity for distributors across India.

## Shop by category
- [Hair care](https://attriindustries.com/category/hair): Onion shampoo, hair oils and natural hair care.
- [Skin care](https://attriindustries.com/category/attri-skin): Face washes, glutathione glow cream and Ayurvedic skin care.
- [Wellness](https://attriindustries.com/category/wellness): Supplements, herbal toothpaste, Tulsi drops and sanitary care.
- [Kitchen Masale](https://attriindustries.com/category/kitchen-masale): Pure spice blends and powders.
- [All products](https://attriindustries.com/category)

## Earn with Attri
- [How to earn money from Instagram in India](https://attriindustries.com/earn-from-instagram): Free creator programme — post your Attri QR code and referral code in stories, earn 25% of a product's distribution value on direct sales and 21/18/12/9/7/5% on levels 2–7 of your team. No follower minimum, no joining fee.
- [Create a free account](https://attriindustries.com/signup)
